expected_mechanical_connections: Revolute slew connection: chassis to upper body through the bearing/gear assembly.
Pinned stick-to-bucket connection plus the multi-link bucket actuation loop.
Three motor/screw actuators change boom, stick, and bucket linkage position; these are screw-driven RC actuators, not hydraulic cylinders.
Track-drive wheel revolute motion and repeated articulated track links.
assembly_structure.native_mate_preservation: Original .SLDASM bytes are preserved; no constraints were removed or edited. Presence, completeness, and solvability of native mates remain unverified.

intended_physics_task.benchmark_value: Several separate articulated bodies, three screw actuators, a bucket linkage loop, slewing bearing, and a detailed tracked base require assembly interpretation and physics authoring.
intended_physics_task.bounds: This is a miniature RC excavator. Soil mechanics, excavation performance, and full-scale hydraulic behavior are not established by the source.
intended_physics_task.execution_handoff: Downstream root owns conversion and simulation on its two Horde nodes / four full GPUs; no GPU or remote-node operations were performed here.
intended_physics_task.primary: After downstream preparation, exercise boom lift, stick extension, and bucket curl through a reach-and-scoop trajectory while monitoring bucket-tip pose, linkage closure, actuator travel, self-collision, and ground contact.
intended_physics_task.secondary: Slew the upper body and assess tipping/contact stability; optionally extend to track-driven traversal.

MIT STEP suspension candidate inspected; 12 unplaced part exports lack assembly placement graph. Superseded by licensed native excavator; candidate downloads are not part of the final acquisition.
Apache-2.0 placed STEP rocker-bogie suspension is a viable alternative, but a licensed native excavator was found.

selection_note: A usable MIT-licensed excavator was found. Native SolidWorks is retained even though STEP/FreeCAD was preferred. No STEP or FreeCAD export exists in this pinned repository snapshot; no conversion was performed. The original printing STLs are supplementary references, not replacements for the CAD assemblies.

why_original_is_not_simulation_ready: The source is a mechanical fabrication CAD package, with native assemblies and printing meshes; it is not a URDF, SDF, MJCF, USD physics scene, or ready simulator model.
The proprietary SolidWorks documents require a compatible CAD reader. Their native mate graph and external/virtual component dependencies have not been parsed or validated.
A simulator still needs rigid-body grouping, joint frames, joint types, limits, collision shapes, and mass/inertia assignments. No verified simulator-specific values are supplied by this curation.
The screw actuators and bucket linkage introduce coupled/closed-loop motion requiring a physics representation and calibrated actuator travel/force parameters.
Detailed gears, bearings, screws, and tracks require choices about contacts, friction, and simplification for stable simulation.
The supplied STL exports are for 3D printing and do not themselves encode articulation or material/physics semantics. Native CAD was preserved alongside them.
